openalex.api_status: Free Public API (No key required, polite email pool recommended)
openalex.citation_tracking: Complete bidirectional citation graph with concepts and open access PDF URLs
openalex.recommended_role: Primary engine for automated literature discovery and citation graph expansion

crossref.citation_tracking: Reference lists and publisher metadata verification
crossref.recommended_role: Primary DOI normalization and metadata validation

arxiv.recommended_role: Preprint discovery and open access full-text source

semantic_scholar.api_status: REST API with free API key
semantic_scholar.rate_limit: 1 req/s without key, 100 req/s with key
semantic_scholar.citation_tracking: Influential citation counts and TLDR summaries
semantic_scholar.recommended_role: Citation impact ranking and automated filtering

ieee_xplore.api_status: Subscription / Dev API Key Required for automated queries; Web export free
ieee_xplore.recommended_role: Targeted manual/hybrid search for premier device characterization papers

nature_springer.api_status: Springer Nature Meta API (free key available); Open access articles fully open

acs_pubs.api_status: Web search with RIS/BibTeX export; Crossref metadata
acs_pubs.recommended_role: Nanoscale interface and chemical doping study extraction

c2db.api_status: Direct open download (ASE db, web REST API)
c2db.recommended_role: Primary source for pristine and defected 2D MoS2 intrinsic properties

materials_project.api_status: MP-API Python SDK (Requires free MP API key)
materials_project.recommended_role: Primary source for bulk contact metal electronic and thermodynamic properties

nist_srd.api_status: Public domain web access and tables
nist_srd.recommended_role: Standard experimental work functions and ionization potentials

crc_handbook.recommended_role: Standard electronegativities, radii, and resistivity benchmarks
